leftEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
leftEvidence.title: Caleb quiets the people and urges immediate possession

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Caleb silences the people before Moses and calls for immediate ascent and possession.
points.right: The other men say Israel cannot go up because the inhabitants are stronger, and they spread an evil report about the land.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: His confidence is stated against the report of strong cities and inhabitants.
points.right: They describe a land that eats its inhabitants, unusually tall people, Nephilim, and themselves as grasshoppers.

payload.posture: Caleb and the ten assess the same land, inhabitants, and fortified cities but reach opposed conclusions about action.

rightEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
rightEvidence.title: Ten men deny Israel’s ability and spread an evil report

payload.tension: Their disagreement concerns ability, threat, and the weight given to the LORD’s promise, not the existence of obstacles.
payload.title: Able to possess or unable to go up
